privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.translation_note: This is a translation of the original Korean-language Privacy Policy, provided for reference. In the event of any discrepancy, the Korean original governs.
privacy.intro: {{brandName}} ("the Company") places great importance on protecting users' personal information. The Company complies with the personal information protection provisions of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, and the Personal Information Protection Guidelines established by the Ministry of Information and Communication, and has established this Privacy Policy in accordance with applicable law to do its utmost to protect users' rights and interests.

sections.heading: 1. General Provisions
paragraphs: Through this Privacy Policy, the Company informs users of the purposes and manner in which the personal information they provide is used, and what measures are taken to protect that information.

The Company's Privacy Policy may change due to changes in government laws and guidelines, or the Company's own terms and internal policies. When it is revised, the Company will immediately post the changes on the homepage in an easily recognizable way.

sections.heading: 2. Personal Information Collected and Collection Methods
paragraphs: ▶ Categories of Personal Information Collected

The Company collects the following personal information for member registration, smooth customer consultation, and the provision of various services. In addition, information such as the following may be generated and collected during the course of using the service or processing business.
- Name, resident registration number, ID, password, address, email address, phone number
- User's browser type and OS, service usage records
- IP address, visit date/time, service usage records, records of improper use
- Delivery address, payment records (account numbers, credit card numbers, and related passwords are not collected), number of cookies
- Collection through generated-information collection tools
▶ Methods of Collecting Personal Information
The Company collects personal information through the following methods.
- Homepage, fax, phone, consultation board, email, event applications, delivery requests

All information you provide is not used for any purpose other than as required, and if the scope, purpose, or use of the collected information changes, the Company will always obtain your prior consent.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of Collecting and Using Personal Information
paragraphs: The Company uses collected personal information for the following purposes.

Fulfillment of contracts related to service provision and settlement of fees for service provision, content delivery, shipment of goods or invoices, identity verification, purchases, and payment of fees
▶ Member Management

Identity verification for membership services and limited real-name verification, personal identification, prevention of fraudulent use and unauthorized use by delinquent members, confirmation of intent to join, restriction on the number of memberships and sign-ups, record-keeping for dispute resolution, handling of complaints, and delivery of notices
▶ Development of New Services and Marketing

Development of new services and provision of customized services, provision of services and advertising based on demographic characteristics, verification of service effectiveness, provision of event and promotional information, identification of access frequency, and statistics on members' service usage

sections.heading: 4. Sharing and Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties
paragraphs: The Company uses users' personal information within the scope disclosed in "3. Purpose of Collecting and Using Personal Information," and in principle does not use it beyond that scope or disclose it to outside parties without the user's prior consent. However, the following are exceptions.

Cases where users have given prior consent to disclosure. This includes cases where the Company provides personal information to subcontractors (affiliated companies) as described below in order to provide the service.
Other cases where the Company reasonably believes disclosure is required by law (e.g., where a government or investigative agency makes a request through lawful procedures under applicable law).

sections.heading: 5. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information
paragraphs: While you remain a member of the Company and receive the services the Company provides, your personal information will continue to be held by the Company and used to provide the service.

In principle, users' personal information is destroyed without delay once the purpose of its collection and use has been achieved. However, the following information is retained for the periods specified below, for the reasons stated.
▶ Reasons for Retention Under the Company's Internal Policy
Records of fraudulent use — Reason for retention: prevention of fraudulent use / Retention period: 1 year
▶ Reasons for Retention Under Applicable Law

Where retention is required under the Commercial Act, the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce, or other applicable laws, the Company retains member information for the period specified by the relevant law. In such cases, the Company uses the retained information only for the purpose of retention, and the retention periods are as follows.
▶ Records of contracts or withdrawal of subscription — Reason for retention: Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce / Retention period: 5 years
▶ Records of payment and supply of goods — Reason for retention: Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce / Retention period: 5 years
▶ Records of consumer complaints or dispute handling — Reason for retention: Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce / Retention period: 3 years
▶ Records of identity verification — Reason for retention: Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection / Retention period: 6 months
▶ Records of visits — Reason for retention: Protection of Communications Secrets Act / Retention period: 3 months

sections.heading: 6. Procedures and Methods for Destroying Personal Information
paragraphs: In principle, users' personal information is destroyed without delay once the purpose of its collection and use has been achieved. The Company's procedures and methods for destroying personal information are as follows.

▶ Destruction procedure: Information entered by a user for member registration, etc., is transferred to a separate database (or, in the case of paper records, a separate filing cabinet) once its purpose has been achieved, stored for a set period in accordance with internal policy and other applicable laws regarding information protection (see Retention and Use Period), and then destroyed. Such personal information is not used for any purpose other than retention unless required by law.

▶ Destruction method: Personal information printed on paper is destroyed by shredding or incineration. Personal information stored in electronic file form is deleted using technical methods that make the records unrecoverable.

sections.heading: 7. Installation/Operation of Automatic Personal Information Collection Devices and How to Opt Out
paragraphs: The Company uses 'cookies' that store and periodically retrieve users' information in order to provide services tailored to each user. A cookie is a small piece of information sent by the server (HTTP) that operates the website to the user's computer browser, and it may be stored on the hard disk of the user's PC.
▶ Purpose of Using Cookies

The Company uses cookies to identify ID information in order to provide users with more suitable and useful services. Cookies identify a user's computer but do not personally identify the user. By using cookies, the Company can understand users' visit and usage patterns, search terms, and audience size for each of the Company's services and websites, allowing it to create and offer more convenient services and provide information optimized for each user.
▶ Installation/Operation of Cookies and Opting Out

Users can choose whether or not to allow cookies. By setting options in your web browser, you may allow all cookies, require confirmation each time a cookie is stored, or refuse the storage of all cookies.
Example setting method (Internet Explorer): Tools at the top of the web browser > Internet Options > Privacy
However, if you refuse to allow cookies to be stored, you may not be able to use some of the Company's services that require login.

sections.heading: 8. Technical/Administrative Protection Measures for Personal Information
paragraphs: In handling users' personal information, the Company takes the following technical/administrative measures to ensure security so that personal information is not lost, stolen, leaked, altered, or damaged.
▶ Password Encryption
Members' passwords are stored and managed in encrypted form and are known only to the member. Personal information can only be checked or changed by the member who knows the password.
▶ Measures Against Hacking

The Company does its best to prevent members' personal information from being leaked or damaged due to hacking or computer viruses. The Company regularly backs up data to prepare against damage to personal information, uses the latest antivirus programs to prevent users' personal information or data from being leaked or damaged, and enables the safe transmission of personal information over the network through encrypted communication. In addition, the Company uses an intrusion prevention system to control unauthorized access from outside, and strives to equip itself with every possible technical device to secure system-level security.
▶ Minimization and Training of Staff Handling Personal Information

The Company limits the staff who handle personal information to designated personnel, assigns them separate passwords that are regularly updated, and continuously emphasizes compliance with the Company's Privacy Policy through ongoing staff training.
▶ Operation of a Dedicated Personal Information Protection Body

The Company also operates an in-house dedicated personal information protection body to verify implementation of the Company's Privacy Policy and staff compliance, and strives to immediately correct any issues that are found.

However, the Company assumes no responsibility for problems arising from the leakage of personal information such as ID, password, or resident registration number due to the user's own negligence or issues on the internet.

sections.heading: 9. Personal Information Manager and Contact Details
paragraphs: The Company designates a Personal Information Manager and staff responsible for collecting opinions on and handling complaints regarding personal information. Their contact details are as follows.
▶ Personal Information Manager
- Name: {{ceoName}}
- Affiliation/Title: CEO
- Email: {{brandEmail}}
- Phone: {{brandPhone}}

You may report any personal-information-related complaints arising from your use of the Company's services to the Personal Information Manager or the responsible department. The Company will respond promptly and thoroughly to users' reports.
If you need to report or seek consultation regarding any other personal information infringement, please contact the following organizations.
1. Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (www.1336.or.kr / 1336)
2. Information Security Mark Certification Committee (www.eprivacy.or.kr / 02-580-0533~4)
3. Supreme Prosecutors' Office Internet Crime Investigation Center (http://icic.sppo.go.kr / 02-3480-3600)
4. National Police Agency Cyber Terror Response Center (www.ctrc.go.kr / 02-392-0330)
If the Company revises this Privacy Policy, it will announce the changes through a notice on the website (or individual notice).

privacy.effective_note: This policy is effective as of December 1, 2014. (Any additions, deletions, or amendments to this policy will be announced on the homepage at least 7 days in advance.)

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.translation_note: This is a translation of the original Korean-language Terms of Service, provided for reference. In the event of any discrepancy, the Korean original governs.

sections.heading: Article 1 (Purpose)
paragraphs: The purpose of these Terms is to set out the rights, obligations, and responsibilities of users and {{brandName}} in connection with the use of the internet-related services (the "Service") provided by {{brandName}} through its website (http://www.hfenglish.co.kr).

sections.heading: Article 2 (Effect and Amendment of the Terms)
paragraphs: ① These Terms take effect when they are posted on the service screen and the user agrees to them.

② {{brandName}} may amend these Terms when a reasonable cause arises, and where the Terms are amended, {{brandName}} will announce the change in the same manner as set out in Paragraph 1 at least 7 days in advance.
③ Unless otherwise specifically stated, any new service that is launched will be provided in accordance with these Terms.

sections.heading: Article 3 (Definition of User)
paragraphs: "User" means a person who accesses the "Site" and receives services provided by {{brandName}}.

sections.heading: Article 4 (Membership Registration)
paragraphs: ① A person who wishes to become a "Member" applies for membership by entering member information according to the registration form set by {{brandName}} and clicking the "Register" button.
② {{brandName}} registers an applicant under Paragraph 1 as a member unless the applicant falls under any of the following.

1. Where the applicant has previously lost membership status under Article 6, Paragraph 3 of these Terms. However, this does not apply where more than one year has passed since the loss of membership status under Article 6, Paragraph 3, and {{brandName}} has approved the applicant's re-registration.
2. Where the registered information contains false statements, omissions, or errors.
3. Where {{brandName}} determines that registering the applicant as a member would significantly interfere with its technical operations.
③ A membership agreement is formed at the point when {{brandName}}'s approval reaches the applicant.
④ If any change occurs to the member information entered under Paragraph 1, the member must immediately correct and update the information.

sections.heading: Article 5 (Suspension of Service)
paragraphs: ① {{brandName}} may temporarily suspend the provision of the Service in the event of maintenance, replacement, or failure of computers or other information and communications equipment, or a communications outage, and may completely discontinue the currently provided Service due to a replacement with a new service or any other reason {{brandName}} deems appropriate.

② In the case of service suspension under Paragraph 1, {{brandName}} will notify users in the manner set out in Article 7, Paragraph 2. However, this does not apply where prior notice is not possible due to a cause beyond {{brandName}}'s control (e.g., a disk failure or system outage not caused by the intent or negligence of the system administrator).

sections.heading: Article 6 (Withdrawal and Loss of Membership Status)
paragraphs: ① A user may request {{brandName}} at any time to cancel their membership registration (withdrawal), and {{brandName}} will proceed to cancel that user's membership registration immediately upon receiving such a request.
② Where a user falls under any of the following, {{brandName}} may restrict, suspend, or revoke that user's membership status by an appropriate method.
1. Where the user registered false information at the time of applying for membership.
2. Where the user interferes with another person's use of the "Service" or misappropriates another person's information, thereby threatening the order of electronic transactions.
3. Where the user uses the "Service" to engage in conduct prohibited by law or these Terms, or conduct contrary to public order and good morals.

① Where {{brandName}} decides to revoke a user's membership status, it will cancel the member's registration. In this case, {{brandName}} will notify the member before canceling the registration and give the member an opportunity to explain.
② Where a "User" who has registered as a member under these Terms has no login record for the "Service" for a continuous period of 1 year, {{brandName}} may revoke that user's membership status.

sections.heading: Article 7 (Notices to Users)
paragraphs: ① {{brandName}} may give notice to a specific user at the email address provided by that user to {{brandName}}.
② Where {{brandName}} gives notice to an unspecified number of users, it may substitute individual notice by posting the notice on the {{brandName}} bulletin board for at least 7 days.

sections.heading: Article 8 (Protection of Users' Personal Information)
paragraphs: {{brandName}} endeavors to protect users' personal information, including registered user information, in accordance with applicable law. Matters concerning the protection of users' personal information are governed by applicable law and {{brandName}}'s Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Article 9 (Retention and Use Period of Personal Information)
paragraphs: ① Personal information is retained until the member cancels their membership, and {{brandName}} retains member information until the point of cancellation.
② A member may use the Service until they cancel their own membership.

sections.heading: Article 10 (Obligations of {{brandName}})
paragraphs: ① {{brandName}} shall not engage in conduct prohibited by law or these Terms, or conduct contrary to public order and good morals, and shall endeavor to provide the Service continuously and stably in accordance with these Terms.
② {{brandName}} shall establish a security system to protect users' personal information (including credit information) so that users can use the "Service" safely.
③ {{brandName}} shall not send unwanted commercial advertising emails to users.

sections.heading: Article 11 (Users' Obligations Regarding ID and Password)
paragraphs: ① Except where {{brandName}} is responsible under applicable law or its "Privacy Policy," each user is responsible for managing their own ID and password.
② A user must not allow a third party to use their ID or password.

sections.heading: Article 12 (Obligations of Users)
paragraphs: (1) When applying for membership or changing member information, a user must enter all information under their real name and based on fact, and may not assert any rights if they register false information or another person's information.

(2) Members shall comply with the matters set out in these Terms, other rules established by {{brandName}}, notices and other matters announced by {{brandName}}, and applicable law, and shall not engage in conduct that interferes with {{brandName}}'s business or damages {{brandName}}'s reputation.
(3) If any matter relating to the use agreement, such as address, contact information, or email address, changes, the member must promptly notify {{brandName}} through the applicable procedure.

(4) Except where {{brandName}} is responsible under applicable law or the "Privacy Policy," the member is responsible for all consequences arising from the member's negligent management or improper use of the password assigned to their ID.

(5) A member may not conduct commercial business activities using the Service without {{brandName}}'s prior consent, and {{brandName}} is not responsible for the results of any such business activities. In addition, if {{brandName}} suffers damages as a result of such business activities, the member shall be liable to compensate {{brandName}} for those damages, and {{brandName}} may restrict that member's use of the Service and claim damages, etc., through lawful procedures.

(6) A member may not transfer or gift their right to use the Service or their other status under the use agreement to another person, or provide it as security, without {{brandName}}'s express consent.
(7) Members shall not infringe the intellectual property rights of {{brandName}} or any third party.
(8) Members shall not engage in any of the following conduct, and where a member does so, {{brandName}} may restrict that member's use of the Service and impose sanctions including lawful measures.
* Registering false information when applying for membership or changing member information
* Misappropriating another user's ID, password, or resident registration number
* Trading a user ID with another person
* Impersonating {{brandName}}'s management, staff, or affiliated personnel

* Modifying {{brandName}}'s client program, hacking {{brandName}}'s servers, or arbitrarily modifying any part or all of the website or posted information, without having been granted special rights by {{brandName}} to do so
* Harming the Service or intentionally interfering with it

* Reproducing information obtained through the Service for purposes other than using the Service, or using it for publication, broadcasting, or providing it to a third party, without {{brandName}}'s prior consent
* Transmitting, posting, emailing, or otherwise distributing to others information, sentences, graphics, sounds, or videos that are vulgar or obscene and that violate public order and good morals

* Transmitting, posting, emailing, or otherwise distributing to others content that is insulting or relates to another person's private affairs in a way that may infringe that person's honor or privacy
* Harassing or threatening another user, or repeatedly causing distress or inconvenience to a specific user
* Collecting or storing another user's personal information without {{brandName}}'s approval
* Conduct that is objectively determined to be connected with a crime
* Violating these Terms or any other rules or conditions of use established by {{brandName}}
* Any other conduct that violates applicable law

sections.heading: Article 13 (Deletion of Public Postings)
paragraphs: Where the content of a user's public posting falls under any of the following, {{brandName}} may delete that posting without prior notice to the user, and may restrict, suspend, or revoke that user's membership status.
1. Content that defames another user or a third party or damages their reputation through slander or malicious rumor.
2. Content that disseminates information, sentences, graphics, etc., that violate public order and good morals.
3. Content determined to be related to criminal conduct.
4. Content that infringes the copyright or other rights of another user or a third party.
5. Any other content determined to violate applicable law.

sections.heading: Article 14 (Copyright in Postings)
paragraphs: (1) Copyright in a posting that a member posts within the service screen belongs to the member who posted it. {{brandName}} may not commercially use a posting without the poster's consent, except for non-profit purposes, and {{brandName}} holds the right to display the posting within the Service.
(2) Members may not commercially use materials posted on the Service, including by arbitrarily processing or selling information obtained through use of the Service.

sections.heading: Article 15 (Amendment of the Terms)
paragraphs: ① {{brandName}} may amend these Terms to the extent it does not violate applicable laws such as the Act on the Regulation of Terms and Conditions, the Framework Act on Electronic Commerce, the Electronic Signature Act, and the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection.

② Where {{brandName}} amends these Terms, it will specify the effective date and reason for the amendment, and announce the amendment together with the current Terms on the initial screen from at least 7 days before the effective date until the day before the effective date.

③ "Users" have the right to refuse the amended Terms. A "User" may express their refusal within 15 days after the amended Terms are announced. Where a "User" refuses, {{brandName}} may terminate the contract with that "User." If a "User" does not express refusal within 15 days after the amended Terms are announced, they will be deemed to have agreed to the amendment.

sections.heading: Article 16 (Jurisdiction)
paragraphs: Disputes concerning use of the Service arising between {{brandName}} and a user are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, and any lawsuit arising from such a dispute shall be filed in a court of the Republic of Korea having jurisdiction under the Civil Procedure Act.

terms.effective_note: Addendum — These Terms apply as of December 1, 2011.
